title: woodmod
description: biomes + blocks + items + alpha version = the best mod*
body:
### woodmod is a mod for 1.21.1 neoforge minecraftt, currently in the first alpha version it adds:

- One biome
- One entity
- Five tools
- Three blocks
- One plant
- Sixteen items
- Twenty six recipes
- Fiveteen custom achievements
- And one dimension

**Remember this is currently in alpha, expect bugs that will be fixed through out updates**

### Dependencies:
Neoforge
Minecraft 1.21.1
